descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-16 ER; TFA-92594 AC 1 · “entries display collapsed with a line count”.

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S13 Expand, collapse, leave the tab, reload: entries always display collapsed and stay listed

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'. (TFA-92594 AC 1)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Same seed as S05 on {hospitalPatient} and as S06 on {snfResident}

When Hospital: open the '(prior)' row and tap it again; open it again, go to Pre-Round and back to Encounter; open it again, reload and return to Encounter. Nursing Home: open the later visit row, reload /snf/<id> and return to Encounter

Then A second tap collapses the row. After a tab switch or a reload, the rows are still listed with their counts and are collapsed, in both modes

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1, cp2 and cp3 each mustContain '(prior)', '3 lines' and mustNotContain QA16-H-Y1, QA16-H-Y2, QA16-H-Y3 (U3 collapsed on display; T1 toggle). cp4 (Nursing Home after reload): mustContain '· Visit notes' and mustNotContain QA16-N-V1, QA16-N-V2, {hospitalPatient} (U3, U8)

Where it ran: dev unit U20; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S13

Expand, collapse, leave the tab, reload: entries always display collapsed and stay listed

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U20.verdict.json), unit U20 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 87 turns, 316 s, $0.55.

Plan: unit U20 (#20, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Prior transcripts: collapse state and cross-patient. S13's seed (Ana, Vera) is part of S15's (Ana, Ben, Vera) with the same fields; both only open and close rows. Runs together with TC-16/S15.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #20, U20; checked: yes): Pass — rows stay collapsed and listed across retap/tab switch/reload; each chart only its own transcripts, both contexts. Observation (perf, needs a human): chart reload on dev showed 'Loading…' ~60 s (U11: two 30 s waits)
